title: Reach starts open
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0051 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Superseded in full by the reach concept and 0142: every agent starts with the harness's default tools and may dispatch whom its work calls for.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
